final: WITH p AS (SELECT a.translink AS translink, t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY a.translink, t.tradekind), s AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS share FROM p), g AS (SELECT translink, tradekind, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS avgshare FROM s) SELECT tradekind, AVG(cnt) AS avg_record_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avgshare) AS avg_excess FROM g WHERE share > avgshare GROUP BY tradekind
